title: Tale of the Fall of Constantinople - parallel interlinear edition (obdurodon.org)
notes: arranz.obdurodon.org (live 200) hosts the interlinear collation digital edition of the East Slavic 'Povest' o vzjatii Car'grada' (Tale of the capture of Constantinople), developed by Isabel Arranz del Riego from her 2013 UCM dissertation and maintained by David J. Birnbaum with XML/RelaxNG files and the three Hilandar Monastery witnesses 281 (1561), 280 (1585) and 282 (1826) - the first two are exactly the harvested witnesses ('witness HM281 (1561)', 'witness HM280 (1585)'). Released under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Isabel Arranz del Riego (Universidad Complutense de Madrid); maintained by David J. Birnbaum (University of Pittsburgh, obdurodon.org)
